message:
feat(fe): single lookup tank arrival CG with zero unusable fuel (#531)

* feat(fe): single lookup-tank arrival CG for zero unusable fuel

Subtract F(q) - F(q - b) of the validated total-moment table from the
current M&B takeoff moment for exactly one category-available lookup tank
with arm null and unusable fuel exactly zero. Nonzero unusable fuel,
fixed arm plus lookup and multiple available tanks with lookup geometry
stay unsupported; fixed-arm paths are unchanged.

Refs #529

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(fe): document partial single lookup-tank arrival CG scope

Requirements REQ-FE-034..036, architecture contract, README, roadmap and
changelog. Nonzero unusable fuel remains unsupported pending #530.

Refs #529

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(fe): cached-offline lookup-tank arrival CG journeys and print

Both planning modes with zero/partial/full burn, out-of-range correction,
category/method/profile resets, unsupported nonzero unusable fuel, missing
origin and multiple tanks, offline reload and print consistency with
retained warning and profile markers.

Refs #529

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(fe): share SI bounds without importing the mocked M&B adapter

Refs #529

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(fe): lookup-tank arrival CG offline evidence

Refs #529

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
